## Requirements (from the spec)

1. **PG-backed queue.** With a DSN, `/review-queue` reads PG `review_item`
   (filterable by the `er_match:camera_site:` / `er_match:camera_site_disputed:`
   prefixes, tier, and bucket; `er_match:identity_duplicate:*` excluded from the
   camera-site queue); `decide` writes through `PgReviewQueue.decide` with the
   pseudonymous curator id; `accept`/`reject` only reach PG — "unsure"/defer
   writes **no** `review_decision`. Demo seed stays the no-DSN default.
2. **Evidence view.** Both observations per pair (source, coordinates at the
   curator's §19.4 tier, external refs, operator, description), the distance,
   the matcher tier and score, and any soft conflict. No raw person data.
3. **Campaign sampler.** `sig-resolution review sample --dsn … --strata …
   --n …` — stratified, seeded, reproducible; spans 1g/3g/4g/5g + soft-conflict
   + disputed; auto-write tiers included on purpose; campaign-tagged
   (append-only); default ≈400 pairs (§6 Q11) as the Round-10 design.
4. **Offline path.** `review export` / `review import` — JSONL labelling
   sessions writing the same append-only decisions.
5. **Tests.** PG decide → `review_decision` row w/ curator id; demo path
   unchanged w/o DSN; sampler reproducible per seed; zero-JS public pages
   unaffected; `/curate/**` within ADR-068.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] decisions via the curation app land as PG `review_decision` rows with the
      pseudonymous curator id (real PG)
- [ ] the stratified sampler is reproducible and campaign-tagged (append-only)
- [ ] hosted: sampler runs read-only (strata counts recorded); a default-size
      campaign may be materialized append-only, labelled prepared-for-Round-10;
      the operator can open the loopback app against the hosted DSN
      (walkthrough below). **No decisions are required**
- [ ] `npm --prefix web run check` + `make check` + `make test-db` green;
      D-P30.2b-1 note appended (stays OPEN); D-R6.1-EVAL untouched (OPEN)

## Design decisions (recorded)

- **Campaign tag = new append-only tables** `review_campaign` +
  `review_campaign_item` (sqitch change `review_campaign`): `review_item`
  payloads are immutable (insert-only), so campaign membership needs its own
  append-only relation. Same shape as the other materialize artifacts:
  deterministic ids, `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` (+0 re-run), no UPDATE/DELETE
  grants.
- **Strata are predicates, not a partition.** `disputed` = the
  `camera_site_disputed:` prefix OR `active_learning:adjudicator_disagreement`;
  `soft-conflict` = `reason LIKE 'soft_conflict:%'`; tier strata = payload
  `tier` — a soft-conflicted 3g item belongs to *both* `3g` and `soft-conflict`
  (tier-3 proposals are exactly the soft-conflicted ones, and the audit intent
  is "humans see every stratum"). The campaign assigns each drawn item to the
  first stratum (spec order) that drew it.
- **Curator tier → geo tier (§19.4):** anonymous/registered → tier 2 (1 km
  grid), trusted_reviewer → tier 1 (2 dp truncation), curator/maintainer →
  tier 0 (full precision — the claims are sensitivity_tier 0, published C1 =
  "exact", and these tiers hold SENSITIVITY_CLASSIFICATION). The view records
  the applied tier so the reduction is auditable.
